projects.title: Aimee Venturina Portfolio
projects.description: My professional portfolio website featuring software engineering projects, AI applications, automation workflows, creative experiments, and my journey as a builder and lifelong learner.

projects.title: MeeMee's Microgreens Shop
projects.description: A responsive React-based e-commerce application for selling fresh, locally grown microgreens, featuring product browsing, shopping cart functionality, and a streamlined checkout experience.

projects.title: News App
projects.description: A responsive news web application built with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Bootstrap that integrates with a third-party News API to fetch and display real-time articles. Features include category filtering, article search, asynchronous data fetching, and a modern, user-friendly interface.

projects.title: Marginalia
projects.description: A RAG-based reading companion that answers questions grounded in your own uploaded documents, with cited sources.

projects.title: Typing Speed Test
projects.description: A browser-based typing speed test built with vanilla JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Tracks real-time WPM, highlights correct and incorrect keystrokes as you type, and includes mobile-device detection.

projects.title: AI with Aimee
projects.description: A high-performance blog documenting my AI learning journey and tech insights. Built with Astro for speed and simplicity, deployed on Vercel.
